name: EZ Bar Seated Curl
steps: Sit upright on a flat bench with your feet planted firmly on the floor and hold an EZ bar across your thighs using an underhand grip.
Pin your elbows against your sides and keep your chest tall.
Curl the bar smoothly upward toward your shoulders until your biceps are fully contracted.
Lower the bar slowly back until it lightly touches your thighs before starting the next repetition.
tips: Avoid bouncing the bar off your thighs to initiate the curl.
Keep your back straight instead of leaning backward as the bar rises.
